findings.statement: CA9 is held by tumor cells: RCC cells carry 0.976 of tissue transcripts (54.7% of cells expressing, cpm_share 0.958), so the bulk signal is tumor-intrinsic.

Paired by donor, CA9 is higher in tumor cells than in proximal tubule (log2FC 7.739, padj 0.0189, 6 donors). Bulk log2FC extrapolated to purity 1 stays at 7.787 (SE 0.579), so infiltration does not explain it.

The best CA9 MGD site scores 0.546 (pLDDT 90.3, volume 126.8 A3, 1 accessible lysine). Ligand-site recall is only 0.5 (recall_in_top_pockets 0.221), so this is a modest site and not evidence that a glue exists.
KDR is an endothelial (microenvironment) gene: endothelium holds 0.951 of tumor transcripts (40.5% of cells expressing, cpm_share 0.979). It is not a tumor-cell target.
CD74 is immune: cDC (cpm_share 0.311, 100% expressing) and macrophages (0.436 of transcripts, 99.5% expressing) dominate. It is a microenvironment gene.
CXCR4 is lymphoid: CD8 T cells hold 0.563 of transcripts (72.9% expressing) and CD4 T cells show 87.8% expressing. It is an immune microenvironment target.
EPAS1 transcripts are mostly not in RCC cells: endothelium has cpm_share 0.626 (81.3% expressing) and RCC has a 0.051 transcript share (4.9% expressing). Its bulk signal is stromal in this dataset.
MET is mainly tumor-cell: RCC holds 0.935 of transcripts (35.2% expressing, cpm_share 0.682). Endothelium has 12% expressing.
EGFR is mainly in RCC cells (0.948 of transcripts, 29.7% expressing, cpm_share 0.542), with a low per-cell fraction expressing.

CD70 is up in tumor and keeps its signal at purity 1 (log2FC 4.278, SE 0.724). It has clinical-stage antibodies and ADCs (vorsetuzumab, cusatuzumab) up to PHASE_2, and no AlphaFold pocket analysis is available for it.
NNMT is tumor-intrinsic: log2FC at purity 1 is 5.256 (SE 0.617) and the protein log2FC is 2.709. It has no clinical drug in the graph.

COL23A1 is a tumor-track first-in-class candidate: RCC holds 0.881 of tumor transcripts, there are 7 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, and the vital-organ maximum nTPM is 3 (heart muscle). Tumor cells vs proximal tubule give log2FC 5.366 (padj 0.0193). Its AlphaFold model is poor (pLDDT 58.91, best MGD site 0.2342, volume 8.0 A3), so it is not a glue candidate, and its tractability is antibody-based. It is a data-ranked hypothesis with no dependency evidence, and the literature is counted by gene symbol.

RAB42 is a tumor-track first-in-class candidate: RCC holds 0.627 of tumor transcripts, there are 2 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, and the vital-organ maximum nTPM is 2.6 (lung). Its AlphaFold model is confident (mean pLDDT 85.31) and its best MGD site scores 0.5348 (volume 37.4 A3, 3 accessible lysines). That volume is small, and ligand-site validation was not checked. It is a hypothesis without functional evidence.

LRRC25 is an immune-track candidate carried by macrophages (0.787 of tumor transcripts) with 0 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, and a bone marrow nTPM of 31, so there is an off-tumor hematopoietic risk. Its best MGD site scores 0.4825 (mean pLDDT 70.31, volume 43.0 A3). It is a macrophage microenvironment hypothesis, and ligand-site validation was not checked.

GAL3ST4 is an immune-track candidate: macrophages hold 0.972 of tumor transcripts, there is 1 ccRCC paper, no clinical drug, and it is antibody-tractable. It is a hypothesis with no functional evidence.

HMCN1 is a stroma-track candidate carried by endothelium (0.719 of transcripts) with 8 ccRCC papers and no clinical drug. Its tumor log2FC is only 1.13 and the lung nTPM is 19.4, so it is a weaker hypothesis.

OLFML2A is a stroma-track candidate carried by fibroblasts (0.647 of transcripts) with 2 ccRCC papers and no clinical drug. Colon expression is 27.9 nTPM. Its protein log2FC is 1.07, and it is a hypothesis without a dependency.

caveats: Discovery candidates are data-ranked hypotheses without dependency or functional evidence; literature is counted by gene symbol.
MGD scores rank sites, not degraders. Most volumes are small (below 170 A3), and ligand-site validation is only available for CA9 (recall 0.5).
Single scRNA-seq cohort (12 donors). Some groups are small (PT n=39, one donor).
CD70 has no structural analysis available.
Endothelial and immune genes (KDR, CD74, CXCR4, EPAS1) are microenvironment targets, not tumor-cell targets.
